liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Sugaree** (3 reviews): Listener calls this one of the better Sugaree performances on that specific tour; Listener calls this performance a thing of beauty and the first set smokes [12][17][19]
- **Estimated Prophet** (2 reviews): The jam sequence from Estimated Prophet through One More Saturday Night is highlighted; Listener finds Jerry's guitar work in this song smooth, soothing, and floating [12][16]
- **Jack Straw** (1 review): Listener describes this performance as intense [17]
- **Playing In The Band** (1 review): Listener describes this version as one of the spacier performances of the song [13]

## The recordings

- **gd77-05-28.sbd.obv.31952.sbeok.shnf** (recommended): matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 26 songs; 193 min; rated 4/5 by 11 [1]
- **gd1977-05-28.aud.wise.goodbear.77267.sbeok.flac16**: FM broadcast; 24 songs; 200 min; rated 4/5 by 4 [2]
- **gd1977-05-28.mtx.chappell.sb30b.97017.flac16**: matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 21 songs; 192 min; rated 4.4/5 by 5 [3]
- **gd77-05-28.sbd.sacks.4983.sbefail.shnf**: soundboard; 20 songs; 188 min; rated 4.76/5 by 34 [4]. Said about its sound: Listener describes the soundboard recording as super sounding and the band as tight; The wonderful quality of the recording enhances the smoothness of the guitar notes; Listener praises the great sound quality of the recording [15][16][20]
- **gd1977-05-28.sbd.ashley-bertha.12827.sbeok.flac16**: soundboard; 21 songs; 187 min; rated 4.5/5 by 8 [5]

## Around the show

- Listener notes the crowd going nuts as the band jams into Not Fade Away [19]
- Listener says the first notes of Bertha signal that the show is going to be awesome [23]
- Listener states this show is no different from other blockbusters on that tour [18]
- Listener says this show lacks the power and energy of the May 22, 1977 show [19]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd77-05-28.sbd.obv.31952.sbeok.shnf**: transferred by The Wizard; source: Soundboard patched with Audience [1]. Also: Uploader applied a mild continuous noise filter and equalization to reduce tape hiss; A two-second dropout in Bertha was patched using the audience source [1]
- **gd1977-05-28.aud.wise.goodbear.77267.sbeok.flac16**: taped by Teddy Goodbear; transferred by Teddy Goodbear; source: Panasonic AM/FM Stereo 'boom box like' w/condenser mics) > CM (Cassette Masters) > various equalizers & editors > CD or DAT [2]. Also: Uploader notes these are not high-quality soundboard sounding tapes [2]
- **gd1977-05-28.mtx.chappell.sb30b.97017.flac16**: transferred by Chris Chappell; source: Matrix mix (SBD/AUD) [3]. Also: SBD lineage traces from Bettyboard 7-inch master reel to DAT to CDR to Shn; Audience source recorded by Jerry Moore using Sony ECM-33Ps and Sony TC-153 [3]
- **gd77-05-28.sbd.sacks.4983.sbefail.shnf**: source: Soundboard [4]. Also: Reviewer notes the recording is a Betty Board, which they feel improves the show [14]
- **gd1977-05-28.sbd.ashley-bertha.12827.sbeok.flac16**: transferred by Jay Ashley; source: SBD>MSR>DAT>CD>>WAV>>DAW(Bertha)>>CDA [5]. Also: Recording was digitally remastered on a custom dual-DAW system nicknamed Bertha; Jack Warner patched reel flips in Bertha and One More Saturday Night from AUD [5]

## Art and photos

- Poster by LiveGRATEFUL.net: [Grateful Dead 1977-05-28 Sat Jerry's first of 21 performances at Hartford Civic Center Hartford Civic Center, Hartford, ](https://www.livegrateful.net/post/1378111605008/grateful-dead-1977-05-28-sat-jerrys) [25]
